headline: Hamas dismisses Israeli claim of using Al Ahli hospital as interrogation center
label: NEWS
caption:
Hamas has dismissed Israeli claims regarding the use of a Gaza hospital. 🚨

According to Anadolu, Hamas has called the Israeli claim that it used Al Ahli hospital as an interrogation center ridiculous.

The statement comes amid ongoing military actions and disputes in the region regarding the use of medical facilities.

Further details from the ground remain limited as officials exchange statements.
